name: Voice of the Gods
body:
School transmutation [language-dependent]; Level cleric/oracle 2, paladin 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, DF

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration 1 round/level; see text

DESCRIPTION

The volume and timbre of your voice increase, so that it sounds as if the power of your deity is bolstering your words. As long as you continue to speak encouraging words or sing a hymn of your god for the remainder of the spell’s duration, all allies within a 50-foot radius of you will be immune to fear. Enemies within the same area must make a Will save or be frightened (those succeeding on their saves will only be shaken). If you stop speaking or singing before the normal end of the spell’s duration, the spell’s effects will linger for one more round.
